material_observation.private_factory_digest: MediatedSemanticState is a Python object passed to execute_mediated_reentry_only in the behavior-capable wrapper process. Its slots include the nominally private _factory_sha256 used by _validate_seal. Python underscore naming is not an isolation boundary; wrapper code can read the attribute directly.
material_observation.uniqueness: 4/4 factory digests are distinct on the exact accepted subject.
material_observation.same_wrapper_order: The repository helper executes all four admitted states sequentially in one parent pytest/wrapper process. Arbitrary behavior-capable wrapper code can also retain invocation count across trials. A public-field-only state test therefore cannot establish per-trial treatment blindness by itself.

counterexample.factory_digest_lookup: A wrapper can contain a preregistered digest lookup and branch on semantic_state._factory_sha256 without parsing canonical_semantic_json. On the replayed subject the four observed values are sufficient to recover the ABBA treatment assignment 4/4.
counterexample.order_state: Even after state metadata minimization, a persistent wrapper can count calls and map call indexes 1/4 to allow and 2/3 to deny under the fixed ABBA schedule unless each behavior-capable trial process is externally fresh/isolated.

interpretation.current_93354_subject: Already invalidated for target freeze by the executed public trial_process_identity PRODUCT_NEGATIVE; this packet does not create a second invalidation scope.

Factory/source/wire/topology/readback metadata must remain in an external verifier process/receipt, not in the behavior process.
